summaries.en: Alibaba's "open-code-review" is a fast, efficient code review tool designed for large-scale use. Written in Go, it is compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic models. The project has gained significant traction on GitHub, boasting over 25,000 stars and 1,850 forks.
